messages:
samira: Uploaded new interactive build for the routing policies editor: /staging/routing/editor-playground. Quick UX + a11y pass please — focus: rules builder, ordering, validation copy, preview simulator.
noah: glanced through it. main confusion is rule evaluation order. users keep asking "which rule runs first?" Visual ordering looks bottom-first due to shadows. Suggest: persistent left-side numeric badge starting at 1 (1 = evaluated first) and a small label 'Evaluated first' pinned to the top.
nash: keyboard/drag issues: drag handle appears only on hover and there's no keyboard reorder action. proposal: a row-level focus target with explicit actions (Move ↑, Move ↓, Duplicate). Keyboard shortcuts: Alt+Up / Alt+Down to reorder. Add aria-grabbed and aria-dropeffect to draggable rows.
ben: validation copy: current message is 'Invalid condition'. Need actionable messages e.g. 'Unknown attribute: request.headers["x-client-id"] in condition #2. Click "Insert placeholder" to add a sample value.' Also include link to the conditions docs.
a11y-bot: quick accessibility scan results: 3 issues. 1) disabled-rule pill contrast ratio 2.7:1 (fail for small text). 2) draggable rows missing aria-grabbed and aria-dropeffect. 3) no visible focus indicator on row-level controls.
samira: simulator feedback: love the live preview. Feature request: batch replay of sample requests (CSV upload or paste) and a per-request trace that highlights which rule matched, the evaluated values, and any fallbacks. Compact UI idea: show a small vertical stripe per request with dots for evaluated/matched/fallback; hover shows reason.
noah: microcopy tweak: change 'Fallback to compatible variant' to 'Fallback to secondary model (reduced capacity)' — clearer for non-ML PMs. Also change label 'Priority' -> 'Priority (higher runs first)'.
ash: insertion behavior: when you add a new rule while a row is selected, insert above the selection. Add an editor preference: default new-rule position (Top / Bottom). Add tiny helper text: 'Higher priority rules are evaluated first.'
ben: small UX quality: auto-generate rule names instead of 'New rule', e.g., from conditions: 'Prefix: summarize' or 'Header x-client -> fallback'. Makes lists scannable.
samira: will update Figma frames with: 1) persistent numeric badges, 2) row-level focus controls and keyboard shortcut hint, 3) refined validation copy + doc links, 4) batch replay UI mock + compact traces, 5) insertion preference and helper microcopy.
a11y-bot: Reminder: full accessibility review scheduled next Monday 10:30 PT.
noah: action items: @ash draft keyboard + ARIA spec, @ben update validation wording + add quick-fix buttons, @samira update Figma and simulator mocks, I'll wire up the preference and numeric badges in the prototype.
samira: great, i'll post updated frames and a short walkthrough clip before Friday. ping me if you want to pair on keyboard tests or the accessibility follow-up. :rocket:
